title: Consultation on draft ITS on FIU-to-FIU exchanges

AMLA’s open public consultations are open to all stakeholders with an interest in the EU’s anti money laundering and countering the financing of terrorism (AML/CFT) framework.

AMLA particularly welcomes input from obliged entities in both the financial and non-financial sectors, including specifically from smaller obliged entities, as the Guidelines are intended to apply across different sectors, business models and entity sizes. AMLA also welcomes contributions from service providers involved in outsourcing and other third-party arrangements, as their practical experience is important for assessing the operational feasibility of the proposed framework.

Stakeholders are invited to provide practical evidence on the proportionality and operational feasibility of the proposed framework, including proposal on simplification and proportionate approach for smaller and low risk entities and arrangements.
Via a public hearing, AMLA is consulting on a draft Implementing Technical Standard (ITS) that introduces common formats for the exchange of information between Financial Intelligence Units (FIUs).

The instrument introduces six standard templates for the exchange of information between FIUs on FIU.net, the secure channel for FIU cooperation across the EU. It strengthens the existing system by ensuring that information sent through it is more complete and consistent, addressing the operational gaps and potential delays that inconsistent submissions have caused. The instrument also harmonises key terminology, including terms related to consent for the further use or dissemination of information.
